name: yen_schema
description: Every kind, aspect and invariant of the fleet.

name: yen_check
description: Invariants: violations, incomplete, ok, and the why rules of each violation.

name: yen_context
description: One scope: parent, children, aspects, elements given and received, errors.

name: yen_explain
description: Why an aspect is active, inactive or undefined at a scope.

name: yen_errors
description: Error records, optionally only one code.

name: yen_declared_in
description: The files that answer a declaration path.

name: yen_export
description: The fleet as sorted N-Triples with sha256 and count. The agent decides whether to store it.

name: yen_stage
description: Evaluate a change (a module as JSON) without applying it: ok, errors, violations, diff, refused, sha.

name: yen_queries
description: The stored-query catalog: each query with its required and optional parameters and their types.

name: yen_ask
description: Run a stored query by name with an args object. A ref is its identity: {kind,name} an instance, {kind} a kind, {aspect} an aspect. Errors (missing-param, ref, unknown query) come back as the result.

name: yen_impact
description: The scopes an element of a scope reaches over routed elements, by depth.

name: yen_labels
description: Trust labels per aspect; with floor n, the edges whose aspect has trust below n.

name: yen_why_not
description: Whether an invariant is violated at a scope, and the why/whyNot rules for it. By reference: invariant is its name, scope an instance {kind,name} with one scope.

name: yen_program
description: Dry-run a change program (list of op objects): valid, errors, ok, violations, diff.
